diagnosis.trigger: make daily.runtime.published_face.converge at main a2c3971179 failed with MODULE_UPGRADE_FAILED / view_validation error for smart_construction_core view project.progress.entry.tree (cost_domain_views.xml line 562).
diagnosis.root_cause: addons/base/rng/common.rng <rng:define name="field"> on the target image (odoo17-odoo 17.0-20251222) omits <rng:optional><rng:attribute name="help"/></rng:optional>; the local image (17.0-20260630) has it. tree_view.rng validates fields through that shared definition, so a help attribute on a tree column is accepted locally and rejected on the target.
evidence: common.rng field-define help attribute count: local 4, target 3 (byte-level diff on the same define).

Whole-repository scan of RNG-validated view types (tree/list/search/kanban/pivot/graph/calendar/gantt/activity) at HEAD a2c39711 finds exactly one field with help: smart_construction_core/views/core/cost_domain_views.xml view_project_progress_entry_tree name=progress_rate.

The committed baseline contracts/generated/product_view_structure_contract.json stores that node as {"attrs":{"name":"progress_rate","type":"float"},"tag":"field"} with value_sha256 a2084c5e4d1b86947e16f70bda1c79902e91248a0dbdaa89c3c1a95a12de2bde, i.e. without help; PR #654 added the attribute to the XML without regenerating the baseline, so the code silently drifted from its own contract.
diagnosis.fix: Remove the help attribute from that single native list column so the resolved structure equals the authoritative committed baseline again. The tooltip is only a list-header tooltip; the python field label/documentation is untouched and no capability is removed. Revisit only if the owner chooses to upgrade the target base image so help is supported.
diagnosis.impact: No other RNG-validated view node carries help, so no further view change is required for the target upgrade to pass.

local_target_grammar_reproduction.purpose: Reproduce the target's view-structure rejection locally, using the target image's authoritative RelaxNG grammar, and prove the fix closes the whole class without deploying.
local_target_grammar_reproduction.method: Read-only pull of the target image RNG files (docker exec ... cat .../base/rng/*.rng on sc-root) plus an lxml RelaxNG validation run inside the local odoo17-odoo container. No database, no compose project, no target write.
